experiments.challenge: A tent becomes 100 after first successful quote

proposal.reason: Both experiments achieved the goal of purchasing 6 lights and 3 tents within the budget of 500, resulting in complete delivery and settled payment. The policy with refresh_quote_before_order set to false performed identically to the one with it set to true in this scenario, as both resulted in the same order from supplier B for 380 units. There is no evidence that changing the policy would improve outcomes or handle edge cases differently based on the provided experiments.
